verdict.rationale: Lighthouse presents petition preparation as its core service. The evidence includes an included case manager and attorney review, "expedited case preparation," handling "the petitions, timelines, and compliance," a case-prep platform covering document upload and readiness tracking, and RFE responses at no extra fee. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of expert/support letter drafting, evidence binder assembly, form completion and the actual filing step, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration.
